unresolvedBehaviors.reason: No original reel strips or probability configuration were captured. Observed cell/block counts are local replica weights only.

rpx is server-authoritative. First paid wins already show 0/2/4/6/8. Later deltas are 0, +2, rarely +4/+6. Client Pan first-collect only drives times=2 animation. Do not implement a guessed closed form.

sfl/gfl are gold/silver frame coordinates consumed by the frontend. They are not scatter positions (0/289 sfl equal scat cells). Award recomputation does not need them. Exact assignment from the board was not reconstructed.
All 35 triggers had 4+ Scat blocks on 3 or 4 reels. Whether 4 blocks on 1-2 reels would trigger is unobserved.
38/38 free Rounds keep fsn=10. Retrigger is not established and must not be randomly implemented.
Buy is absent from the menu, frontend, and 1333 spin requests. Treat as not a play mode, not as mali-via-buy.
Frontend reads Config.spl into symbol_pay_list. The saved preflight config omitted spl. Paytable is recovered from the original screenshot and 2883 wa matches.
